rubrics.current_prompt_guidance: B questions start with Describe. The exact question stem varies; use the prompt and indicative content on the question-specific mark scheme.
rubrics.descriptor_policy: Display the attached official PDF table verbatim. Numerical bands are shared by question type; preserve the component-specific descriptor wording.

rubrics.exact_scheme_source: Exact descriptor PDF assets are extracted from the corresponding Summer 2025 component mark scheme. Each question separately links its original scheme for indicative content.
rubrics.current_prompt_guidance: Explain; use the relevant Christianity or Islam prompt and its indicative content.
rubrics.descriptor_policy: Display the attached official PDF table verbatim. Numerical bands are shared by question type; preserve the component-specific descriptor wording.

rubrics.command: Discuss this statement. Show that you have considered more than one point of view. Refer to religious beliefs and teachings in your answer.
rubrics.mark_scheme_source: Use the official mark scheme PDF linked from the question record for its question-specific indicative content.
rubrics.mark_bands_source: 2025/26 Eduqas D-question guide, question d except Route A Component 1 2d and Route B Component 1 1d.
rubrics.mark_bands_source_pages: Use the exact band descriptors from the 2025/26 official guide, page 3. The 2026 paper wording is in the Summer 2026 newsletter.

rubrics.command: Discuss this statement. Show that you have considered more than one point of view. Refer to religious beliefs and teachings in your answer. Refer to non-religious beliefs, such as those held by Atheists and Humanists, in your answer.
required_perspectives: non-religious beliefs, for example Humanist or Atheist views
rubrics.mark_bands_source: 2025/26 Eduqas D-question guide, special Route A Component 1 2d band descriptors. The guide names Humanists and Atheists as examples of non-religious beliefs.
rubrics.mark_bands_source_pages: Use the exact special band descriptors from the 2025/26 official guide, page 4. The updated 2026 prompt is in the Summer 2026 newsletter.
rubrics.note: The current rubric requires a reference to non-religious beliefs. The official band descriptors name Humanists and Atheists as examples.

rubrics.mark_bands_source: Use the SPaG descriptors in the matching official mark scheme. Mark the response first, then assess spelling, punctuation and grammar separately.
rubrics.eligibility_rule: Offer this optional SPaG score only when the source question has a separate SPaG allocation (spag_marks is not null).
rubrics.scoring_rule: When the student opts in, mark spelling, punctuation and grammar separately for up to 6 additional marks. If they leave it off, omit the 6 marks from the practice paper total.
rubrics.actual_exam_note: Up to 6 SPaG marks are allocated to 1(d) in each of Components 1 and 2. None are allocated in Component 3. In this site, SPaG scoring remains optional for eligible practice questions.

rubrics.exact_scheme_source: Exact descriptor PDF assets are extracted from the corresponding Summer 2025 component mark scheme. Each question separately links its original scheme for indicative content.

content_rules.rule: Refer to either two religions or two religious traditions. Humanism or another non-religious philosophy does not count as one of the two.

rubrics.current_prompt_guidance: C questions start with Explain. Component 1 Route A requires two religions or two religious traditions.
rubrics.descriptor_policy: Display the attached exact Component 1 C table, which explicitly assesses diversity. Two religions or two religious traditions are required.

binding_rule: Reuse band tables within the applicable question type and component. Show question-specific indicative content alongside the appropriate official band table. Component 1 C and Life and Death 2(d) retain their distinct descriptors.
version_note: This dataset uses the current 2026 command wording for question prompts, the current 2025/26 D rubric, and the latest full public question-specific B/C mark schemes located (Summer 2025). The 2026 full exam papers and schemes are in Eduqas’s password-protected portal according to its Summer 2026 newsletter.
spag_practice_setting: Optional per practice paper; disabled by default. Only offer it on questions where the official source allocates SPaG marks.
rubric_wording_source: Summer 2026 Eduqas newsletter, pages 2–3. Historical prompts remain stored verbatim; generated D practice instructions use the current rubric.
